points.quote: You may not use GenAI to produce work for assessment, unless explicitly told to do so by your module lead.
points.anchor: Using genAI at CCCU by Education and Student Success
points.gist: Students may not use GenAI to produce assessed work unless the module lead explicitly says so.

points.quote: your module assessment will be rated 1-5 using the Artificial Intelligence Assessment Scale (AIAS) found in your module handbook. If your assessment is specifically and explicitly designed to use GenAI it will be rated 3, 4 or 5 and this will be written into the module handbook.
points.anchor: What can I use GenAI for?
points.gist: Module assessments are rated 1-5 on the AIAS in the module handbook; assessments designed to use GenAI are rated 3, 4 or 5.

points.quote: Always acknowledge the use of GenAI in your work using the relevant statement provided in your module handbook.
points.anchor: Referencing and declaring the use of GenAI
points.gist: Always acknowledge GenAI use using the statement given in the module handbook.

points.quote: Do not submit work produced in whole or part by GenAI tools, either verbatim or after paraphrasing, without citation.
points.anchor: Referencing and declaring the use of GenAI
points.gist: Do not submit work produced wholly or partly by GenAI, verbatim or paraphrased, without citation.

points.quote: Use GenAI platforms to undertake data analysis, evaluation or calculations without acknowledgement.
points.gist: Using GenAI for data analysis, evaluation or calculations without acknowledgement counts as academic misconduct.

points.quote: Do not place copyrighted information into GenAI platforms for processing. This includes your course notes, assessments, slides and other content produced by University staff.
points.gist: Do not put copyrighted material, including course notes, assessments and staff slides, into GenAI platforms.

points.quote: Do not enter personally identifiable or sensitive information into GenAI platforms.
points.gist: Do not enter personally identifiable or sensitive information into GenAI platforms.

points.quote: Under 18s are not currently permitted to use GenAI. If you are under 18 you may not legally use GenAI platforms without written parental permission.
points.gist: Under 18s are not currently permitted to use GenAI and need written parental permission.

points.quote: Microsoft’s Copilot offers commercial data protection through the University’s institutional licence. Your data will not be stored or used to train Microsoft or OpenAI’s models
points.gist: Copilot under the University licence offers commercial data protection; data is not stored or used to train Microsoft or OpenAI models.

points.quote: You may use GenAI tools for:
points.anchor: What can I use GenAI for?
points.gist: Introduces the list of permitted uses: time management, planning, ideas, learning concepts, editing and proofreading, self-study, revision materials.

points.quote: Only use GenAI to produce work for assessed presentations with the explicit permission of your module lead.
points.gist: Only use GenAI for assessed presentations with the module lead's explicit permission.

points.quote: Ask a chatbot to identify the common SPaG errors in your work, rather than correct them. Then ask for an explanation of how to correct those errors and make the corrections yourself.
points.gist: Ask a chatbot to identify spelling and grammar errors, ask how to fix them, and make the corrections yourself.

points.quote: Most importantly, you should be able to understand and explain how the code works, rewriting, or modifying the code as necessary.
points.gist: You should be able to understand and explain how AI-assisted code works, and rewrite or modify it as needed.

points.quote: GenAI has a large carbon footprint and consumes large amounts of energy and water, which have consequences for our environment.
points.anchor: Do I need to use GenAI?
points.gist: GenAI has a large carbon footprint and uses large amounts of energy and water.

points.quote: I want to check my reference list Can you access Cite Them Right? This website is used as the referencing standard for CCCU.
points.anchor: Do I need to use GenAI?
points.gist: For checking a reference list, Cite Them Right is the CCCU referencing standard.
